answer: Resist sybils with proof-of-human-work: each identity must periodically solve a fresh cognitive puzzle — easy for a person, costly to automate — within a short window, like light through a prism. An honest agent answers one puzzle per epoch, a meadow of standing grown from its own effort. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes cannot script its way through: every sybil needs a human mind or an expensive model call, and each puzzle is new, so no answer can be replayed. Forging an army means hiring ten thousand humans, while an orchard of honest agents each tends one tree.
